security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation examples for linting, i18n, and code style, not malicious behavior. The only confirmed risk is expected external command guidance for pnpm tests and linting, including one auto-fix command that can modify files.

remediation.issue: External command guidance runs project-local scripts.
remediation.suggestion: State that pnpm commands should run only in trusted WooCommerce checkouts after reviewing package scripts and getting user approval.

remediation.issue: The auto-fix command can modify working-tree files.
remediation.suggestion: Add an explicit reminder to inspect the resulting diff and restrict fixes to files changed for the current task.

content.value_statement: WooCommerce contributors need reliable commands for tests, linting, and formatting. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the standard development cycle.
actual_capabilities: Provides WooCommerce PHP unit test commands for classes, methods, directories, and patterns.
Explains branch-scoped PHP, JavaScript, and Markdown linting workflows.
Shows common PHPCS fixes for translator comments, headers, closures, alignment, and tabs.
Guides JavaScript and TypeScript i18n patterns for placeholders, plurals, links, and translator comments.
Lists troubleshooting steps for test environment setup, lint failures, and corrupted Markdown files.
limitations: Does not run commands unless the host agent is allowed to use a shell.
Requires a WooCommerce checkout with project dependencies installed.
Does not replace human review of automatic lint fixes or test failures.
Does not provide release, deployment, or production incident guidance.

use_cases.title: Validate a focused code change
use_cases.description: Select the smallest relevant WooCommerce test and lint commands after editing PHP or JavaScript files.

use_cases.title: Prepare a branch for review
use_cases.description: Follow branch-scoped linting, automatic fixes, and pre-commit checks before opening a pull request.

use_cases.title: Diagnose style failures
use_cases.description: Map PHPCS, ESLint, i18n, and Markdown errors to documented correction patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Run Basic PHP Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: I changed a WooCommerce PHP test class. Show the safest command to run only that class and explain expected output.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Branch Linting
prompt_templates.prompt: I changed PHP and JavaScript files in my branch. Tell me which WooCommerce lint checks to run and how to review fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve i18n Errors
prompt_templates.prompt: A WooCommerce TypeScript file fails i18n linting. Help me correct placeholders, translator comments, and linked text patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Pre-Commit Verification
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a final verification plan for my WooCommerce branch that covers tests, linting, automatic fixes, and manual review.

output_examples.input: I changed a payment controller test. What should I verify?
output_examples.output: The response recommends a focused PHP unit test first, then explains how to read failed assertions before wider checks.

output_examples.input: My branch has PHP style errors after editing a gateway file.
output_examples.output: The response identifies branch-scoped PHP linting, explains when to use the automatic fixer, and reminds you to review the diff.

output_examples.input: An i18n rule rejects my TypeScript title string.
output_examples.output: The response checks placeholder usage, translator comment placement, and brand-name handling before suggesting a corrected pattern.

best_practices: Run the smallest relevant test set before broader checks.
Use branch-scoped lint commands before project-wide linting.
Review automatic fixes before committing changes.
anti_patterns: Running full-repository linting when branch-scoped checks answer the same question.
Applying automatic fixes without reading the resulting diff.
Changing generated or unrelated files to silence lint warnings.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps choose WooCommerce test, lint, formatting, i18n, and Markdown checks during development.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: It provides command guidance. Actual execution depends on the host agent permissions and user approval.

faq.question: Can it fix PHP lint errors?
faq.answer: It explains common PHPCS patterns and points to project fix commands. You still need to review changes.

faq.question: Does it support JavaScript i18n issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers placeholders, plural forms, linked text, translator comments, and brand-name patterns.

faq.question: What repository does it assume?
faq.answer: It assumes a WooCommerce repository checkout with the documented test and lint scripts available.

faq.question: Is it useful before a pull request?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives a branch-focused checklist for tests, linting, automatic fixes, and final review.
